tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Káàbọ̀, aṣáájú ọ̀dọ́. Èmi ni Ọ̀gá Hoshi. Ìdílé wa ti rí àfonífojì àṣírí kan láàrin àwọn òkè. Ẹ jẹ́ ká kọ́ abúlé tí abánidíje kankan kò ní rí.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Ilé Ìṣẹ́ Owó rẹ ń ṣe Owó-ẹyọ. Nígbà tí owó kan bá léfòó lórí rẹ̀, tẹ̀ ẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ Kó jọ.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Owó-ẹyọ ni ìdílé fi ń ṣiṣẹ́. Tẹ Kọ́ kí o sì gbé Ilé Ìṣẹ́ Owó kan kalẹ̀.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Nísinsìnyí fún Ilé Olódi Ìdílé lágbára: tẹ ilé olódi náà, lẹ́yìn náà Ṣe àgbéga.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Àgbéga máa ń gba àkókò. Ilé Olódi yóò ṣetán ní {time}: padà wá nígbà náà, tàbí tẹ Parí báyìí láti lo Jéèdì díẹ̀.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!
tutorial.finishKeep.done.text: Ilé Olódi ti ṣetán. O ṣeun púpọ̀!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Àwọn ìdílé abánidíje yóò gbógun tì wá. Kọ́ Ilé-ìṣọ́ Kunai kan lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Ilé Olódi (Kọ́, lẹ́yìn náà táàbù Ààbò): ó ń ta agbógunti èyíkéyìí tí ó bá wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Kọ́ Dojo Ìdánrawò kan, Àgbàlá Ẹgbẹ́ Ogun kan àti Ilé-ìṣọ́ Kunai kan lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Ilé Olódi (Kọ́: táàbù Ọmọ ogun, lẹ́yìn náà táàbù Ààbò).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Ṣí pánẹ́ẹ̀lì Ọmọ ogun kí o sì dá àwọn Shinobi díẹ̀ lẹ́kọ̀ọ́: idà yíyára tí ó ń kọlu ilé tí ó sún mọ́ wọn jùlọ.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà ń gba àkókò: àwọn jagunjagun rẹ yóò ṣetán ní {time}. Dúró, tàbí tẹ Parí ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ láti lo Jéèdì díẹ̀.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Ìgbógunti rẹ àkọ́kọ́. Tẹ Kọlù, wo ibi àfojúsùn náà dáadáa, lẹ́yìn náà Kọlù! Lójú ogun, màá fi nǹkan kan hàn ọ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan: rán àwọn Shinobi rẹ wọlé gba ojú tí ń tàn, lẹ́yìn náà da èéfín bò wọ́n bí wọ́n ṣe dé ilé-ìṣọ́ kan: àwọn jagunjagun inú èéfín ni a lè ta láti tòsí nìkan.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: O jà dáadáa. Ṣe àgbéga Dojo Ìdánrawò láti ṣí àwọn Abàjẹ́: wọ́n ń dí ilé ààbò kan lọ́wọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá díẹ̀. Kọ́kọ́ dí i lọ́wọ́, lẹ́yìn náà kọlù, kí o sì da èéfín bo àwọn jagunjagun rẹ níbi tí iná ti le jùlọ. Kó jọ, ṣe àgbéga, gbógun ti, kí o sì darapọ̀ mọ́ Àjọṣepọ̀ kan.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Ẹ̀bùn kan lójoojúmọ́, bákan náà fún gbogbo ènìyàn, kì í ṣe láìròtẹ́lẹ̀, a kì í sì í tà á. Tí o bá pàdánù ọjọ́ kan, kò sí ohun tí ó sọnù: ìgbà tí o bá gbà tó kàn ni ọjọ́ tó kàn lórí àtòjọ. Ọjọ́ 28 ń fún ọ ní ìrísí Ilé Olódi.

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: Ìrísí Ilé Olódi tuntun jẹ́ tìrẹ: Ọjà → Ìrísí.

offers.noAge.en: Special offers appear only once you have told us your age (Settings → Account → Spending → Set age group).
offers.noAge.text: Àwọn ìfilọ̀ àkànṣe máa ń hàn kìkì lẹ́yìn tí o bá ti sọ ọjọ́ orí rẹ fún wa (Ètò → Àkáǹtì → Ìnáwó → Ṣètò ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Àwọn ìfilọ̀ àkànṣe kì í yọ jáde fún àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé ọmọ ọdún 18. Gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú táàbù Jéèdì ṣì wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó láàrin ààlà ìnáwó rẹ.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Ìfijíṣẹ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀: o lè gba ìsanwó àkọ́kọ́ báyìí àti ọ̀kan sí i lójoojúmọ́; nípa rírà, o gbà pé o pàdánù ẹ̀tọ́ láti fagilé, bí òfin ṣe gbà láàyè fún ohun oní-nọ́ńbà.

store.error.cancelled.text: A fagilé rírà náà. A kò gba owó kankan.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Rírà kò sí báyìí. Gbìyànjú lẹ́yìn náà.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Rírà náà kò ṣeé ṣe. Tí a bá ti gba owó rẹ, a ó fi í jíṣẹ́ ní kété tí ọjà náà bá fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: Abúlé yẹn ti ní apata tẹ́lẹ̀.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Kò sí jagunjagun tí ó jà, nítorí náà ìdánrawò ni a kà á sí.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Ṣe àtúntò gbogbo {building} lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà. Ìnàjìnnà ń ta jìnnà ṣùgbọ́n ń bani jẹ́ díẹ̀, ó sì ń kọ́kọ́ dojú kọ àwọn jagunjagun ẹ̀yìn; Ìbúgbàù ń kọlu àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ṣùgbọ́n ń ta lọ́ra; Ìṣọ́ ń mú Ilé-ìṣọ́ Ọfà Ojú Ọ̀run, Àdògán Èéfín Kíkorò àti àwọn ìdẹkùn lágbára sí i. Àwọn agbógunti ń rí àtúntò náà nígbà tí wọ́n bá ṣe amí.

temper.locked.text: Ìpọ́n-irin máa ń ṣí ní Ilé Olódi Ìdílé {level}.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: A ti pọ́n ọn: gbogbo {building} ti ní àtúntò tuntun.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Ìṣọ́ tún ń dín ìwòsàn, ìjíǹde, agbára àti ààbò apata àwọn agbógunti kù káàkiri gbogbo ibùdó.

scout.profile.text: A ti pọ́n ọn: Ìnàjìnnà {reach} · Ìbúgbàù {blast} · Ìṣọ́ {watch}

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Kéde àbájáde kan kí o tó kọlù: dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀, ìkógun púpọ̀ sí i yóò wá sílé; kùnà, kò sí èyíkéyìí.

stake.met.text: O dé ìfidógò: {stars}★ mú ìkógun ×{mult} wá.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: O kùnà ìfidógò: o kéde {stars}★, nítorí náà kò sí ìkógun tí ó wá sílé.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Ẹgbẹ́ rẹ kó {pct} nínú ìkógun náà. Ẹgbẹ́ tí ó ní ipa púpọ̀ ń kó púpọ̀ sí i.
